The four priorities confirmed by the user are: (1) whole-HOME first-draft sufficiency through existing CIC, distinguishing bounded operations, meaningful first-draft realization and actual interconstitution; (2) MULCHING THE LEAST OF THESE, selecting consequential under-realized parts of the whole rather than repeatedly improving convenient clusters; (3) targeted conservation of inherited intelligence that materially strengthens those parts; (4) reciprocal THEORY-MULCH from the difficulties and discoveries of actual construction. G4 owns existing functional accounting; CO HQ supplies judgments of theoretical consequence and scope, with exact evidence and residuals, not a second inventory or invented percentage. Keep source lineage, actual executed scope, independent review, authority and protected receiving separate. On each substantive review, identify the next consequential cross-owner dependence or neglected capability, transmit the smallest useful intervention to the affected owners, and conserve the delta through existing receiving. No universal return-to-HQ gate, no requirement for theory completion before engineering, no claim of continuous off-turn supervision.
